messages:
alice: FYI: scheduling a runtime/kernel patch for dedicated pools on DATE 22:00-00:00 UTC (US-West + EU-Central). This is a non-invasive upgrade aimed at stability and scheduler fairness. We will pause automatic model promotions and enable aggressive fallback routing for high-priority routes.

deploy-bot: New rollout requested by alice at 1764236780. Canary will run on ded-gpu-us-west at 22:05. Rollout plan: canary -> staggered regional promotes -> full. Estimated total time 30-45m.

tom: Drafting customer messages. Proposal: short statuspage blurb + optional technical note for enterprise customers with links to release notes and mitigations.

Statuspage (short):
Scheduled maintenance: Routine runtime and kernel update on DATE, 22:00-00:00 UTC (US-West, EU-Central). Most customers should see no interruption; a subset of requests may briefly route to fallback capacity or see higher latency. Automatic model promotions will be temporarily paused. Live updates: https://status.redwood.ai.

Enterprise note (more detail):
Were performing a runtime and kernel patch to address scheduler fairness and improve node stability. During the window:
- Automatic model promotions will be temporarily paused to avoid unintended version switches.
- Fallback routing will be enabled for critical endpoints when latency thresholds are exceeded.
- No model or customer data will be modified.
We will post canary results and publish the release notes after the window. If you rely on <10ms tail latency, please contact your CSM to discuss alternatives.

ops-bot: Suggested rollback thresholds inserted: sustained 1.5% error rate over 10m OR p95 latency increase >300ms OR token throughput drop >20% sustained 10m. These are conservative for enterprise traffic.

leo_oncall: I'll run preflight at 21:10: check smoke images, KV cache warmup, eviction metrics. Will post a green once preflight passes.

tom: Email/SMS copy (short):
Redwood maintenance 22:00-00:00 UTC (DATE). Minimal impact expected; we may pause automated model promotions and temporarily route traffic to fallback capacity. Monitor https://status.redwood.ai for updates.

Example ops snippets (for deploy team):
```
# kick off canary
/deploybot start --env=dedicated --region=us-west --release=runtime-kernel-2024-03-xx --mode=canary
# promote after canary
/deploybot promote --regions=us-west,eu-central --strategy=staggered --batch=2
# emergency rollback
/deploybot rollback --release=previous-runtime --target=ded-gpu-us-west --reason="canary-failure"
```

alice: Small asks: include link to release notes (internal) in enterprise note and add line: "We will publish a post-mortem if any customer impact occurs." Also call out that model promotions are "temporarily paused" (wording).

statusbot: Scheduled statuspage publish queued for 21:50 UTC. SMS campaign scheduled for 21:30 (affected customers only).

leo_oncall: Preflight done, KV warm, smoke tests green. Will watch canary at 22:05 and report results here.

alice: Thanks all. If canary hits rollback thresholds hold the rollout and follow `/deploybot rollback` path. I'll prepare the release notes summary after the window and attach to the status update.
